title.narrative: Third Phase Disaster Vuln.Reduction APL for Dominica

description.narrative: The objective of the Project is to reduce vulnerability to natural hazards and climate change impacts in Dominica through: (i) investment in resilient infrastructure, and (ii) improved hazard data collection and monitoring systems.
